question: 'Hind Swaraj' the title of the first definitive writing of which freedom fighter is still generating critical interest around the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hind Swaraj **is a book written by** Gandhi in 1909, **which lays out his vision of **Swaraj or self-rule** for India.
 
• The book is written in the form of a **dialogue **between a **reader and the author** and covers topics such as** non-violent resistance,** the role of the state, and the need for** moral regeneration** of the people.
 
• In the book, Gandhi declares his **allegiance** to the greater purposes of empire, but he **rejects European **culture. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was a freedom fighter and the** first Prime Minister** of India.

 
 
• **'The Discovery of India' **is the book he wrote.
 
 
 
• **Lala Lajpat Rai** was a prominent **Indian nationalist leader** and a contemporary of Gandhi.
 
 
• Lala Lajpat Rai wrote two books:** "England's Debt to India" **and "**The Arya Samaj."**
 
 
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji **was a Parsi scholar and nationalist who was the first Indian to be elected to the British Parliament.
 
 
• He wrote** Poverty and Un-British Rule in India.**
